title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1967-03-18
lineage: --Converted raw wav files to 15Hkbps / 48khz using Roxio import Cd function of Roxio Music Creator suite (2009). Pitch Corrected using Adobe Audtion CC 2018. Retracked using Roxio Sound Editor (2009). Encoded .wav files to flac (level 8) using Trader's Little Helper.
taper: This came from an anonymous source via CD.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the rare 3/18/67 Winterland show, highlighting early‑era blues/R&B with standout Jerry Garcia guitar work.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑quality soundboard tape that delivers an organic, clear listening experience prized by blues and roots fans. The performance captures the band in an early‑1967 phase, with raw energy on tracks like “Me and My Uncle” and plenty of Jerry’s soaring lead alongside Pig’s gritty vocals. Overall reviewers are enthusiastic about both the rarity of the show and its solid musical delivery.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are positive (average 4.6 stars) and consistently praise both the performance and the recording quality; weighting favors show quality, yielding a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as high‑quality, crisp, organic and great for blues/roots listening, indicating a clear and well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rare complete early‑67 set that flows naturally through blues‑heavy material, showcasing the band’s raw energy and Jerry’s lead work.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his blues, R&B and psychedelic guitar work; reviewers say they can’t get enough of Jerry.
band_member_comments.Bob: Criticized for adolescent vocal style during this period.
